findings.description: The exemplar shows only one long lower-body path and does not establish a distinct counterbalance-leg flow, so support versus counterbalance is not readable.

The visually dominant body gesture begins at the chin/neck instead of being carried from the crown through a curved facial centre into the neck, so the craniofacial centre gesture is not demonstrated by the exemplar.
findings.contract_clause: owns: craniofacial centre gesture; allowed: dominant crown→face→neck→spine→pelvis→support gesture

findings.description: The head reads as a nearly closed oval construction; it does not clearly teach two subordinate open envelope arcs around an asymmetric facial centre.

records.note: R03 audit finds the bundled P1 grammar exemplar insufficient for the 0.5.2 P1 contract. Do not copy its neck-origin gesture.

findings.description: The corrected exemplar uses single arm/leg direction chains and no paired limb contours, torso mass closure, foot blocks, joint anatomy, clothing block-in, or shading.
The crown-to-support gesture remains visually dominant while P2 head/shoulder/pelvis/limb axes are readable but subordinate.
findings.contract_clause: exemplar.must_show: preserved P1 gesture + primary axes

records.note: R04 replaced the over-developed P2 image with a deterministic direct-stroke axes-only exemplar generated from sources/p2_axes_v2.json.

findings.description: The simple foot endpoints are somewhat descriptive, but remain within the contract’s allowed simple endpoint vocabulary and do not add articulated joint detail.

records.note: P3 is the only bundled exemplar that currently matches the frozen representation boundary closely enough to PASS.

findings.description: Elbows, knees and several other joints are represented primarily as dots on line chains rather than as directional structural transitions between connected masses.
findings.contract_clause: exemplar.must_show: joint transitions; owns: elbow/wrist transitions and knee/ankle transitions

findings.description: Hip-to-thigh and shoulder insertion relationships are only weakly explained; the exemplar relies on markers more than insertion geometry.

records.note: The exemplar demonstrates joint locations but not the structural transition grammar required by the P4 contract.

findings.description: The exemplar contains extensive tonal hatching/shading across hair, clothing and trousers, exceeding clean block-in scope.
Numerous micro folds and texture marks appear in sleeves, trousers and shoes.
findings.contract_clause: forbidden: micro clothing folds / micro texture

findings.description: Facial and hair rendering are developed enough to read as a finished sketch rather than a clean structural block-in.
findings.contract_clause: detail ceiling: clean block-in / major internal structure only

records.note: P5 currently demonstrates a finished pencil illustration, not the frozen clean-block-in stage.
